{{Short description|Type of uniform tiling in geometry}}
{{Uniform hyperbolic tiles db|Uniform hyperbolic tiling stat table|U55_01}}
In [[geometry]], the '''truncated order-5 pentagonal tiling''' is a [[List_of_regular_polytopes#Hyperbolic_tilings|regular]] tiling of the [[Hyperbolic geometry|hyperbolic plane]]. It has [[Schläfli symbol]] of t<sub>0,1</sub>{5,5}, constructed from one pentagons and two decagons around every vertex.
